200:t_2:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm glad you're safe, $$バナージ$$.」

200:t_2:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Are you feeling all right?」

200:t_2:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Even in this situation, you're worrying about others. That's just like you.」

200:t_2:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「There's no need to worry. Thanks to Director $$ナナイ$$, I'm stable now.」

200:t_2:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The $$ガランシェール$$ team has decided to fight under Colonel $$シャア$$.」

200:t_2:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The Captain and the others too...」

200:t_2:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's right. There's no Federation or $$ジオン$$ now... We have things to do for the sake of everyone.」

200:t_2:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Fighting alongside you all taught me to think this way. I'm counting on you from now on, $$バナージ$$.」

200:t_2:15.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「What does it matter if you've failed once or twice?」

200:t_2:16.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「As long as you live, you struggle with all your might... Isn't that who you are, $$バナージ$$?」

200:t_2:18.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You and Master showed me the light. I'd like to return even a little of that to you.」

200:t_2:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「You needn't worry about $$マリーダ$$. She's fighting of her own free will.」

200:t_2:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...You saved us, $$シャア$$. If you and $$葵$$'s team hadn't come, we might have been wiped out there.」

200:t_2:22.en:
$$シャア$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$... Its strength seems to far surpass what we imagined.」

200:t_2:23.en:
$$シャア$$
「I secured an escape route as a precaution. I'm glad it proved useful.」

200:t_2:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Three $$スフィア・リアクター$$s... With our current forces, we have no chance if we fight them all at once.」

200:t_2:26.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm a member of $c too. If we can't do it now, we just have to think about what we do next.」

200:t_2:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You understand that too, don't you?」

200:t_2:29.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll join you for the time being too. Once things settle down, I'll return to space.」

200:t_2:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You mean because of $$フロンタル$$...」

200:t_2:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now that $$プラント$$ has declared its support for $$ネオ・ジオン$$, all the Spacenoids will side with the Empire if we don't hurry.」

200:t_2:32.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll leave $$マリーダ$$ with you. $$クェス$$ is here, and above all, the atmosphere here suits her.」

200:t_2:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The Empire may pursue us relentlessly from now on, you know.」

200:t_2:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, she says she wants to fight here.」

200:t_2:35.en:
$$シャア$$
「I would too, if I could.」

200:t_2:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Understood. ...Now I owe you a great deal.」

200:t_2:37.en:
$$シャア$$
「No... You stopped $$アクシズ$$. That makes us even.」

200:t_2:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're right. It may only be for a short time, but I'll be counting on you.」

200:t_2:39.en:
$$シャア$$
「Here, I'll do my part as just another pilot.」

200:t_2:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The pursuit force is here already?」

200:t_2:41.en:
$$シャア$$
(As I thought, the Empire is beginning to focus its sights on $c...)

200:t_2:42.en:
$$シャア$$
(The vision of despair I saw when I became a $$特異点$$... Is that moment drawing near...?)

200:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This isn't anything supernatural, like getting caught in a $$時空震動$$. We're in trouble purely in military terms...!」

200:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'll have to postpone congratulating our ace pilots until another time!」

200:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With a dimension merchant's sheer guts, I'll at least keep $$Ｄトレーダー$$ open! Today, we'll force ourselves to... do business, business!」

201:t_000:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The Imperial Palace in $$ラース・バビロン$$ is already within combat range!」

201:t_001:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's where the Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$ is...」

201:t_001:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You can tell it's a pompous building just by looking at it.」

201:t_001:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah. He must've felt great looking down on Earthlings from up there.」

201:t_001:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But that ends here...! Now that we've arrived!」

201:t_001:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「We haven't encountered any real resistance so far, but...」

201:t_001:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's the capital. We came knowing they would have some kind of plan laid out.」

201:t_001:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But if the enemy resorts to tricks, we'll break through head-on...! Meet cunning with sound tactics. That is the path to victory!」

201:t_001:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our forces are on par with those we had in the final battle of the $$時獄戦役$$. We've done everything we can for now.」

201:t_001:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our analysis of both sides' forces also shows a chance of victory with a swift breakthrough. Now we just have to carry it out.」

201:t_001:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our target is the Imperial Palace... The place where all the $$レイライン$$s converge...」

201:t_001:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「If we destroy it, we can stop them extracting $$次元力$$ too...!」

201:t_001:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are you ready!? We're charging in!」

201:t_001:14.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All units, be alert! The defense force is coming out!」

201:t_002:0.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「There are so many of them. I expected it, though.」

201:t_002:1.en:
$$シン$$
「It is the imperial capital where the Emperor lives, after all!」

201:t_002:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「But there are no $$リアクター$$s!」

201:t_002:4.en:
$n
「That's too bad. This was my chance to pay $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$バルビエル$$ back.」

201:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「But don't let your guard down. We're dealing with that vicious bastard and a killer.」

201:t_002:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「They must be waiting in the rear...!」

201:t_002:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then we'll drag them out and punch through them too!」

201:t_002:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Our target is the Imperial Palace! We'll scatter the small fry around it!」

201:t_002:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, the first phase of the operation is to break through the enemy's defensive line.」

201:t_003:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If we can't cross that line in four minutes, the operation fails!」

201:t_003:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「We have four minutes against this many enemies...」

201:t_003:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「We knew this would be a hard fight!」

201:t_004:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Come at us if you dare, $$サイデリアル$$!」

201:t_004:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll win this battle. I swear it!」

201:t_004:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We won't let you do as you please with Earth!」
